title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 285 (Settlement of list of contributories and application of assets)

content.overview: As soon as may be after a winding-up order, the Tribunal shall settle a list of contributories, cause the assets to be collected and applied in discharge of the company's liabilities, and may rectify the register of members in all cases where rectification is required under the Act.
content.glance: After winding-up order the Tribunal settles the list of contributories, collects and applies assets, and may rectify the register of members.
content.study: Section 285 requires the Tribunal, as soon as may be after the winding-up order, to settle a list of contributories, collect the company's assets and apply them in discharge of liabilities. The Tribunal may also rectify the register of members where the Act requires. The list distinguishes present and past members; past members are liable only in the cases and to the extent the Act provides.

sections.heading: List of contributories
sections.body: Tribunal settles the list of contributories as soon as may be after the winding-up order.

sections.heading: Application of assets
sections.body: Assets are collected and applied in discharge of the company's liabilities.

sections.heading: Rectification
sections.body: Tribunal may rectify the register of members in all cases where rectification is required under the Act.

provisions.title: Settlement of list of contributories and application of assets

examples.title: Settling the list
examples.body: Shortly after the winding-up order the Tribunal settles who is liable as a contributory (present and, where applicable, past members).

hypotheticals.question: When is the list of contributories settled?
hypotheticals.analysis: As soon as may be after the making of a winding-up order, under section 285.

misconceptions.trap: The liquidator alone settles the list without Tribunal involvement.
misconceptions.correction: Section 285 places the duty to settle the list on the Tribunal.
